title: The quest coach's lesson walk (first steps, lessons, arming, pacing)
oneLine: Which onboarding card shows when, per-browser lesson record, armed stamps, first-step order, pacing referee.
topConcern: Login Key lesson locked out after the tutorial (and on short desktop windows the first steps stall at the minimap, which the size guard refuses).

title: The bottom sheet's navigation and the fold (dashboardPanelBus x dashMinBus x interlocks)
oneLine: Bar/expanded mode, drill stack, persisted fold, rotation close, desk open-once, shop/chat interlocks.
topConcern: Six differently-worded 'is the bag on screen' tests and ~25 writer files; agree today only because nothing drills over the dashboard page.

title: The band's dead tap/swipe button and stat tooltip
oneLine: IconButton pressed/swipe classifier and a 3 s tooltip timer that nothing renders or opens.
topConcern: Dead code still described as the live tap/swipe decision; advance/retreat/tapDestination have no callers.

title: The band's pickup watcher (bagUnseen + bagLife feed)
oneLine: 400 ms bag diff marking new keys unseen and popping or bumping tiles.
topConcern: bagUnseen has no reader any more; it only grows and forces re-renders.

title: The first quest's gear glow (gearFlash watcher)
oneLine: 300 ms DOM poller lighting the fold chip, nav button or gear tiles from tut_1 until tut_2.
topConcern: Interval and fold-chip layout reads keep running for the whole session after the phase that needs them ends.

title: The --sheet-h / data-bt-sheet stamp
oneLine: DOM mirror of the sheet's mode and viewport, stamped by the band and BroTown's watchdog, removed on unmount.

title: The controls tour (ControlsTutorial)
oneLine: On-demand modal tour: bus open flag, step index, re-measured steps, both discs held while open.

title: The modal guard (counted screen ownership + notification mute)
oneLine: Reference-counted 'a decision panel owns the screen' that stands the chat composer and feed down.
topConcern: Opt-in list of six call sites; other decision windows (Ace's flip, farm, chest) never push, so the composer's dismiss layer is not stood down for them.

title: 'A panel is open' (uiBusyBus from BroTown's _anyPanelOpen)
oneLine: Boolean published during BroTown's render so chrome outside BroTown's tree stands aside.
topConcern: Windows mounted by GameApp (daily rewards, shop drawer, Ace, chest) are not terms of it; a second definition of busy.

title: The Element Burst button (eligibility, cooldown, busy)
oneLine: Client-stamped 3 s burst cooldown and eligibility gate, redrawn every frame.
topConcern: rAF re-render every frame all session; a server refusal leaves the client cooldown stamp showing a cast that never happened.

title: The death strip
oneLine: Time-gated death record from player_died, cleared at respawn, drawn by a 250 ms poller.

title: The daily chest's claim window
oneLine: Explicit stage string offer/shaking/opening/reveal/error with an 8 s answer timeout.

title: The daily rewards window
oneLine: Open/tab window over the worker's rewards state; quests, season and the Quests dot are off by caps.

title: The 'PLAY FULL SCREEN' install card
oneLine: Once-per-browser iOS card polling the onboarding referee until the screen is quiet.
topConcern: A stale coach-up flag (coach retire skips noteCoach) blocks it for the session; the coach never waits for it.

title: No man's land's 'Attack <name>?' window
oneLine: One ask about one player: raised, held 10 s, answered or let go with a re-ask cooldown.

title: No man's land's plate tap, red line and explainer hit-close
oneLine: 250 ms mirror of NML level and skull into a tap target and red line; HP drop closes the rules.

title: The top bar's small machines
oneLine: Logout confirm, 1.2 s Test panel hold, purse flip, AP rise, XP bar window.

title: The place name latch and the wheel-trip title window
oneLine: Module latch of the last element land (kept over water) and a copy of the 30 s trip-to-BroTown test.
topConcern: placeOf ignores wheelHere's 'fresh' flag, so after a respawn the latch can name the land you died in.

title: Ace's coin flip dialog
oneLine: Request/answer wager machine: open, pending, settled counter, gold and item modes.
topConcern: No request id: a late answer settles the wrong spin after close/reopen; the 6 s guess says 'not enough gold' for a slow answer.

title: The small toasts and the 'Next:' step nudge
oneLine: Capped toast list with per-toast clocks deferred behind loading screens; once-per-label step announcer.

title: The farm's request/answer bus
oneLine: One farm request at a time with its own timeout, worker clock offset and the order board.

title: The eat and light-a-fire mailboxes
oneLine: Single pending-key slot set by a tap and consumed by BroTown's subscriber.

title: The block ring bus
oneLine: Dormant parry window plus a display mirror of the shield, hostile-near flag and a persisted block count.

title: The utility wheel bus
oneLine: Open/badges/activations of the retired radial wheel; only the debug console drives it.

title: Retired HUD pieces: SpecialChargePie and MasteryNotification
oneLine: Unmounted charge-gauge fade and mastery toast queue with combat hold.
topConcern: MasteryNotification's [shown] effect clears its own 4 s timer: a remounted toast would never go by itself.

title: Two small latches: actionBus and capeStatusBus
oneLine: Weapon-handler registration with an only-if-mine unregister; last cape_status payload for late mounts.

title: The dungeon clear card
oneLine: Face of dungeonClear.js's once-only 30 s leave clock and the boss chest row.

title: Lil Bro's race HUD
oneLine: Face of race.js's explicit phase: asked, count, run, done.

title: The XP bar's fill and count animation
oneLine: Snap-then-grow fills, a level-up wrap timer and a self-stopping rAF count.

title: The farm bed prompt
oneLine: 150 ms poll of the farm walk's near-bed step and seed choice.

title: The band's portrait regeneration
oneLine: Async portrait render where only the newest request may land, stopped on unmount.
